fullTitle: AWS Machine Learning Engineer - Associate Practice Test 3

questions.domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML Workflows

They want to automatically set up an environment where multiple data scientists can collaborate, manage various machine learning tasks, and store their work in a persistent and scalable environment. Which feature of SageMaker would best support these requirements?
questions.promptText: A company is building a machine learning pipeline using SageMaker. They want to automatically set up an environment where multiple data scientists can collaborate, manage various machine learning tasks, and store their work in a persistent and scalable environment. Which feature of SageMaker would best support these requirements?

options.text: SageMaker Studio
SageMaker Notebook Instances
AWS Glue
Amazon EMR

questions.promptHtml: Which of the following features of SageMaker Jupyter Notebooks helps ensure that data is not lost during the machine learning workflow?
questions.promptText: Which of the following features of SageMaker Jupyter Notebooks helps ensure that data is not lost during the machine learning workflow?

options.text: On-demand instance provisioning
Pre-installed libraries like TensorFlow and PyTorch
Persistent storage
Real-time inference endpoints

correctText: Persistent storage

questions.promptHtml: A data scientist is working with Amazon SageMaker Studio and needs to set up a JupyterLab environment for collaboration with their team. Which of the following best describes how SageMaker Studio notebooks are different from standalone SageMaker notebook instances?
questions.promptText: A data scientist is working with Amazon SageMaker Studio and needs to set up a JupyterLab environment for collaboration with their team. Which of the following best describes how SageMaker Studio notebooks are different from standalone SageMaker notebook instances?

options.text: SageMaker Studio notebooks are integrated within SageMaker Studio, allowing persistent storage and multiple notebooks per project, while standalone notebook instances operate independently.
SageMaker Studio notebooks are for lightweight tasks, whereas standalone SageMaker notebook instances are used for heavy machine learning workloads.
Standalone SageMaker notebook instances have built-in collaboration tools, whereas SageMaker Studio notebooks do not support collaboration.
SageMaker Studio notebooks are pre-configured only for data preparation tasks and cannot be used for model training or deployment.

questions.promptHtml:
A machine learning engineer is tasked with building a predictive model for an e-commerce platform using Amazon SageMaker. The team is considering whether to use a SageMaker Notebook Instance or SageMaker Studio. The engineer needs the following features:
- The ability to run multiple notebooks in parallel within the same environment.
- A centralized space for persistent storage of datasets, notebooks, and logs.
- Seamless integration with existing AWS services like S3 and IAM.

Which SageMaker environment should the engineer choose, and why?
questions.promptText:
A machine learning engineer is tasked with building a predictive model for an e-commerce platform using Amazon SageMaker. The team is considering whether to use a SageMaker Notebook Instance or SageMaker Studio. The engineer needs the following features: 
- The ability to run multiple notebooks in parallel within the same environment. 
- A centralized space for persistent storage of datasets, notebooks, and logs. 
- Seamless integration with existing AWS services like S3 and IAM. 

Which SageMaker environment should the engineer choose, and why?

options.text: SageMaker Notebook Instance because it allows running multiple notebooks in isolated environments, ensuring that tasks remain independent.
SageMaker Studio because it offers a persistent Jupyter Lab space where multiple notebooks can be managed, allowing centralized data access and integration with AWS services.
SageMaker Studio because it is specifically designed for large-scale deep learning workloads, offering GPU-based instances for parallel notebook execution.
SageMaker Notebook Instance because it provides access to the full AWS CLI, enabling tighter control over resources and configurations.

correctText: SageMaker Studio because it offers a persistent Jupyter Lab space where multiple notebooks can be managed, allowing centralized data access and integration with AWS services.

questions.promptText: A machine learning engineer is using SageMaker Data Wrangler to preprocess data from multiple sources. They want to analyze the relationships between different features in the dataset before selecting which features to include in model training. The engineer also needs to understand which features might have the greatest impact on the target variable. Which two functionalities of Data Wrangler will help the engineer achieve this? options.text: Feature importance visualization using the Quick Model.

questions.promptHtml: A machine learning team is using Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to label a dataset for an object detection task. They want to reduce labeling costs without sacrificing quality. What strategy provided by Ground Truth would BEST help the team achieve this?
questions.promptText: A machine learning team is using Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to label a dataset for an object detection task. They want to reduce labeling costs without sacrificing quality. What strategy provided by Ground Truth would BEST help the team achieve this?

options.text: Fully manual labeling by a private workforce within the organization.
Use a completely automated machine learning model to handle all labeling tasks.
Implement active learning, where a model labels simple cases, and human labelers handle complex cases.
Utilize a third-party vendor for all labeling tasks to ensure the highest accuracy.

correctText: Implement active learning, where a model labels simple cases, and human labelers handle complex cases.

questions.promptHtml:
A data science team is using SageMaker Ground Truth to perform text classification labeling. They are interested in reducing their labeling costs by automating some tasks while ensuring sensitive data is handled by trusted individuals.

Which combination of strategies should the team use to achieve this?
questions.promptText:
A data science team is using SageMaker Ground Truth to perform text classification labeling. They are interested in reducing their labeling costs by automating some tasks while ensuring sensitive data is handled by trusted individuals. 

Which combination of strategies should the team use to achieve this?

options.text: Use a private workforce for sensitive data, and leverage active learning to automate simple tasks.
Set up Mechanical Turk workers for sensitive data and automate labeling for complex tasks.
Use a third-party vendor for sensitive data while relying on fully automated models for all labeling tasks.
Rely entirely on private workforce labelers to handle both simple and complex tasks.

correctText: Use a private workforce for sensitive data, and leverage active learning to automate simple tasks.

questions.promptHtml: A data scientist at a retail company needs to quickly build a machine learning model to predict customer churn. The data scientist has limited time and prefers to avoid the complexity of setting up custom infrastructure or algorithms. Which approach would be most suitable for this scenario using Amazon SageMaker?
questions.promptText: A data scientist at a retail company needs to quickly build a machine learning model to predict customer churn. The data scientist has limited time and prefers to avoid the complexity of setting up custom infrastructure or algorithms. Which approach would be most suitable for this scenario using Amazon SageMaker?

options.text: Use SageMaker built-in algorithms, such as XGBoost, with the provided dataset, specifying only the hyperparameters and instance type.
Build a custom algorithm using TensorFlow on a SageMaker notebook instance, with manual setup for data processing and infrastructure management.
Set up a custom model using a proprietary algorithm on Amazon EC2, ensuring complete control over the infrastructure.
Use SageMaker Jumpstart to deploy a pre-built solution for customer churn prediction without customization.

correctText: Use SageMaker built-in algorithms, such as XGBoost, with the provided dataset, specifying only the hyperparameters and instance type.

questions.promptHtml: An organization is working on a text classification problem and decides to use Amazon SageMaker's built-in algorithms. The team is concerned about optimizing model performance without manually tuning hyperparameters. What features of SageMaker can help address this requirement?
questions.promptText: An organization is working on a text classification problem and decides to use Amazon SageMaker's built-in algorithms. The team is concerned about optimizing model performance without manually tuning hyperparameters. What features of SageMaker can help address this requirement?

options.text: Use SageMaker's automatic hyperparameter tuning with the built-in linear learner algorithm.
Manually adjust hyperparameters for the built-in algorithm by trial and error.
Use SageMaker JumpStart to automatically deploy pre-trained text generation models without any customization.
Utilize custom algorithms to bypass hyperparameter tuning altogether.

correctText: Use SageMaker's automatic hyperparameter tuning with the built-in linear learner algorithm.

questions.domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML Workflows

questions.promptText: Team of data scientists is working on a computer vision project and wants to leverage AWS SageMaker’s built-in algorithms. They plan to use SageMaker JumpStart to streamline the process. What are the key advantages of using SageMaker JumpStart for this project?

Using JumpStart will eliminate the need for any hyperparameter tuning and data preparation.

options.text: Use SageMaker’s built-in algorithms, which come pre-packaged in containers, requiring only data input and hyperparameter setup.

questions.promptHtml:
A pharmaceutical company is using machine learning to analyze clinical trial data. They need to ingest raw data from multiple sources, such as CSV files and relational databases, and clean and join this data. Afterward, the data should be used to create a set of features, including patient age, treatment history, and genetic markers. The company also wants to maintain a version-controlled feature repository that can be reused across different machine learning models.

Which AWS services should the company use to preprocess the data, create features, and maintain a version-controlled feature repository?
questions.promptText:
A pharmaceutical company is using machine learning to analyze clinical trial data. They need to ingest raw data from multiple sources, such as CSV files and relational databases, and clean and join this data. Afterward, the data should be used to create a set of features, including patient age, treatment history, and genetic markers. The company also wants to maintain a version-controlled feature repository that can be reused across different machine learning models. 

Which AWS services should the company use to preprocess the data, create features, and maintain a version-controlled feature repository?

options.text: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler for data preprocessing, SageMaker Feature Store to store and manage the features, and SageMaker Notebooks to train the models.
Use Amazon Athena to preprocess the data, store the features in Amazon S3, and use SageMaker Autopilot to automatically train models.
Use AWS Glue for data cleaning, store features in Amazon DynamoDB, and use SageMaker to train models.
Use Amazon QuickSight for data preprocessing, SageMaker Feature Store to store features, and SageMaker JumpStart to deploy a pre-built model.

correctText: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler for data preprocessing, SageMaker Feature Store to store and manage the features, and SageMaker Notebooks to train the models.

questions.promptHtml:

The company also wants to utilize a pre-built machine learning model to accelerate the deployment process.

questions.promptText:
A manufacturing company is using machine learning to predict equipment failures. The company has data on equipment usage, temperature, and maintenance records stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. They need to clean and analyze this data, engineer features such as average machine temperature over time, and store these features for both batch and real-time predictions. The company also wants to utilize a pre-built machine learning model to accelerate the deployment process. 

Which combination of services would BEST meet the company's needs?

options.text: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to clean and transform the data, store the features in SageMaker Feature Store, and use SageMaker JumpStart to deploy a pre-built predictive maintenance model.
Use SageMaker Notebooks to preprocess the data, store the features in Amazon S3, and use SageMaker Autopilot to train and deploy a predictive model.
Use Amazon EMR to preprocess the data, store the features in Amazon DynamoDB, and use SageMaker to train and deploy the model.
Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to clean and preprocess the data, store the features in Amazon Redshift, and use SageMaker JumpStart to deploy a pre-built model.

correctText: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to clean and transform the data, store the features in SageMaker Feature Store, and use SageMaker JumpStart to deploy a pre-built predictive maintenance model.

questions.promptHtml: Which of the following is the primary advantage of using the Hyperband algorithm for hyperparameter tuning over other methods?
questions.promptText: Which of the following is the primary advantage of using the Hyperband algorithm for hyperparameter tuning over other methods?

options.text: It guarantees that all hyperparameter combinations are tested
It allocates more resources to promising configurations while stopping underperforming configurations early
It randomly selects hyperparameters to reduce training time
It uses prior training results to suggest the next set of hyperparameters to test

correctText: It allocates more resources to promising configurations while stopping underperforming configurations early

questions.promptHtml:
A machine learning engineer is tasked with training a custom PyTorch model using Amazon SageMaker. They want to take advantage of SageMaker's pre-built PyTorch container while maintaining control over the training logic. The engineer also needs to include several custom Python libraries to handle specific pre-processing tasks.

What steps should the engineer follow to set up and train the model using SageMaker's Script Mode?
questions.promptText:
A machine learning engineer is tasked with training a custom PyTorch model using Amazon SageMaker. They want to take advantage of SageMaker's pre-built PyTorch container while maintaining control over the training logic. The engineer also needs to include several custom Python libraries to handle specific pre-processing tasks. 

What steps should the engineer follow to set up and train the model using SageMaker's Script Mode?

options.text: Create a custom Docker container for the model, push it to Amazon ECR, and pull it into SageMaker for training.
Write a Python script with the training logic, specify it as an entry point in the SageMaker estimator, and include a requirements.txt file to install custom libraries during training.
Install the required Python packages directly on the SageMaker notebook instance and run the training using the SageMaker built-in algorithms.
Use AWS Lambda to trigger a training job, passing the model and training script from the notebook instance.

correctText: Write a Python script with the training logic, specify it as an entry point in the SageMaker estimator, and include a requirements.txt file to install custom libraries during training.

questions.promptHtml:
An organization needs to train a machine learning model with a custom algorithm that is not natively supported by SageMaker's built-in algorithms. The organization prefers to use SageMaker’s pre-built containers for framework support, but with custom training and inference code.
Which approach should the organization take?
questions.promptText:
An organization needs to train a machine learning model with a custom algorithm that is not natively supported by SageMaker's built-in algorithms. The organization prefers to use SageMaker’s pre-built containers for framework support, but with custom training and inference code. 
Which approach should the organization take?

options.text: Use SageMaker's built-in algorithms and modify them to include custom training code.
Utilize SageMaker’s Script Mode, write the custom training logic in a Python script, and specify the entry point in a SageMaker estimator.
Build a custom Docker container from scratch, package all dependencies, and upload it to Amazon ECR for use in SageMaker.
Write custom training code directly in the SageMaker notebook instance and run it using the notebook’s execution kernel.

correctText: Utilize SageMaker’s Script Mode, write the custom training logic in a Python script, and specify the entry point in a SageMaker estimator.

questions.promptHtml: You are tasked with training a deep neural network model with billions of parameters using Amazon SageMaker. The model is too large to fit into a single GPU, and the dataset is also substantial. Which SageMaker technique should you use to ensure efficient training?
questions.promptText: You are tasked with training a deep neural network model with billions of parameters using Amazon SageMaker. The model is too large to fit into a single GPU, and the dataset is also substantial. Which SageMaker technique should you use to ensure efficient training?

options.text: Data parallelism, where the dataset is split across multiple machines but the model remains on one GPU.
Model parallelism, where the model itself is split across multiple GPUs, and each GPU handles a portion of the model.
Use only a single machine with larger memory to handle both the data and the model.
Use pre-built SageMaker containers without any adjustments for distributed training.

correctText: Model parallelism, where the model itself is split across multiple GPUs, and each GPU handles a portion of the model.

questions.promptHtml: Which of the following correctly describes the relationship between trials and trial components within SageMaker Experiments?
questions.promptText: Which of the following correctly describes the relationship between trials and trial components within SageMaker Experiments?

options.text: A trial consists of multiple experiments, and each experiment captures metadata about data processing.
A trial is a single training run with specific configurations, and trial components capture different stages of the workflow such as data processing or model training.
A trial component tracks the hardware resources used during training, while a trial compares different algorithms.
A trial captures different models trained in parallel, and trial components represent different datasets used.

correctText: A trial is a single training run with specific configurations, and trial components capture different stages of the workflow such as data processing or model training.

questions.promptHtml:
A machine learning engineer is building a model to predict rare diseases based on a dataset where the majority of patients do not have the disease. To handle the imbalance in the dataset, the engineer is considering using SageMaker Data Wrangler to preprocess the data.

Which technique provided by SageMaker Data Wrangler is the BEST option to address class imbalance without increasing the risk of overfitting?
questions.promptText:
A machine learning engineer is building a model to predict rare diseases based on a dataset where the majority of patients do not have the disease. To handle the imbalance in the dataset, the engineer is considering using SageMaker Data Wrangler to preprocess the data. 

Which technique provided by SageMaker Data Wrangler is the BEST option to address class imbalance without increasing the risk of overfitting?

options.text: Random undersampling to reduce the number of samples in the majority class.
Simple oversampling to duplicate samples from the minority class.
Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) to generate new synthetic samples in the minority class.
Feature scaling to normalize the feature values in the dataset.

correctText: Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) to generate new synthetic samples in the minority class.

questions.promptHtml: A company is developing an AI solution that needs to reduce both underfitting and overfitting to ensure a balanced model. Which combination of strategies can the data scientist apply to mitigate bias and variance in the model? (Choose Two)
questions.promptText: A company is developing an AI solution that needs to reduce both underfitting and overfitting to ensure a balanced model. Which combination of strategies can the data scientist apply to mitigate bias and variance in the model? (Choose Two)

options.text: Use cross-validation to assess model performance on multiple data subsets.

questions.promptText: A machine learning engineer is training a deep learning model on SageMaker using TensorFlow. questions.domain: ML Solution Monitoring, Maintenance, and Security
questions.promptHtml: What does data drift refer to in the context of machine learning model monitoring, and why is it important to detect?
questions.promptText: What does data drift refer to in the context of machine learning model monitoring, and why is it important to detect?

options.text: A situation where the model's predictions deviate from expected outcomes in a systematic way.
A change in the input data distribution over time, making it different from the data used for model training.
